entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, um, I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed with myself. I ordered something and I really need the money back.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Can you please provide me with your order number?
Yes, it's VF88602. It's for a helmet. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I just feel terrible about this. I saved up for it, but things are tight right now.
I understand completely. Thank you for that order number. Just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, it's just a preference. I ordered the wrong color, and it doesn't match my bike at all. It seems silly, but it really bothers me. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it since it arrived.
Not silly at all, getting the right gear is important. Let me pull up your order. Okay, I see it was delivered 20 days ago. Just one moment while I check our return policy for you.
Oh, I really hope you can help. I was counting on getting that refund.

Alright, I've reviewed the policy. Since the item is within 90 days of delivery and is in its original condition, you are absolutely eligible for a full refund. We can definitely process this return for you.
Really? Oh, thank you so much! That's such a huge relief. I was so worried.

Of course. It's important you're happy with your purchase, and having the right equipment is a key part of safety. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on file. Just attach that to the package and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed.
That is wonderful news. Thank you, David. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
